info.name: What the Green King Goblin Wants

descriptions.notStarted: The Guardian Spirit says the Goblins of Kamak Mountain are the only ones that know something about the Old Fox. Go see the #bGreen King Goblin#k at #bDokebi House#k near the Haunted House.
descriptions.inProgress: The Green King Goblin says he will tell everything about the Old Fox only if I get him #b1 plate#k of his favorite #bbuckwheat jelly#k. Let's go buy buckwheat jelly from the Folk Town.  \n\n#i2022051##t2022051#  #b#c2022051##k/1
descriptions.completed: The Green King Goblin revealed how to retrieve a soul from the Old Fox.
